name: Five Point Strike: hybrid-stat kunai
targetName: one Five Point Strike champion hit
objective: Explore high one Five Point Strike champion hit output under the recorded finite setup, comparing item swaps rather than claiming an absolute maximum.
mechanic: Q deals 45/70/95/120/145 + 0.65 total AD + 0.60 AP magic damage. Both offensive stats matter, but lethality does not penetrate this native magic packet.
finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Reference enemy: 10000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR; target current HP 100%, owner HP 100%. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual final stats and eligible rune modifiers. No free permanent stacks. Stop packets at death and distinguish raw output from effective damage/healing. Exactly 10 earned Hubris kills with its temporary buff active. One rank-5 Q with sufficient actual energy.
